fields.description: Save magic: ASCII game title and version stamped in EEPROM blocks 0-1 by the save writer.
fields.evidence: Logical-domain (rev8) bytes 0x00-0x0F read 'TEKKEN 1.00' in samples/baseline.sav; raw bytes are the same data bit-reversed per 8-byte EEPROM block. Covered by the EEPROM write-all loop FUN_08006678 (blocks 0..0x2c) via FUN_08021cf0/FUN_08021bbc; stub.json raw magic [49,32,4E,45] ('1 NE') is the rev8 scramble of this string.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: First header word after the magic; constant 1 in the baseline capture (save format version / validity word).
fields.evidence: Logical u32 value 1 at file offset 0x10, inside EEPROM blocks 0-3 written by FUN_08006678 via FUN_08021cf0. No checksum algorithm in Schema v2 verifies over any range covering it (brute-forced sum/xor/crc layouts), so it is data, not a checksum.
fields.name: save_version

fields.description: Unlock/progress flag word 0 (fresh-save value 0x02000400: bits 10 and 25 set).
fields.evidence: Logical u32 at file offset 0x1C (EEPROM block 3) written by FUN_08006678 via FUN_08021cf0/FUN_08021bbc. Sparse two-bit pattern with zero neighbours matches a fresh-save unlock flag word; sorted per-character ranking state is maintained separately by FUN_080066dc.
fields.name: unlock_flags_0

fields.description: Unlock/progress flag word 1 (fresh-save value 0x08001000: bits 12 and 27 set).
fields.evidence: Logical u32 at file offset 0x20 (EEPROM block 4) written by FUN_08006678 via FUN_08021cf0/FUN_08021bbc. Same sparse flag-word pattern as unlock_flags_0.
fields.name: unlock_flags_1

fields.description: Unlock/progress flag word 2 (fresh-save value 0x00001000: bit 12 set).
fields.evidence: Logical u32 at file offset 0x24 (EEPROM blocks 4-5) written by FUN_08006678 via FUN_08021cf0/FUN_08021bbc. Same sparse flag-word pattern as unlock_flags_0.
fields.name: unlock_flags_2

fields.description: Time-attack record slot 0: slot index, matches its position in the 10-record table.
fields.evidence: Logical u32 value 0 at file offset 0xA0 (EEPROM block 20) written by FUN_08006678. Opens a 10-entry x 12-byte table (0xA0-0x117) whose indices ascend 0-9 and whose times ascend by a constant 0xE10-step default ladder with fighter-name tags.
fields.name: ta_slot_0_index

fields.description: Time-attack record slot 0: best time in raw game ticks (183343 in baseline; default ladder rises 3600 ticks per slot).
fields.evidence: Logical u32 at file offset 0xA4 (EEPROM block 20) written by FUN_08006678 via FUN_08021cf0. Second word of the 12-byte time-attack record starting at 0xA0, followed by the ASCII name tag at 0xA8.
fields.name: ta_slot_0_time

fields.description: Time-attack record slot 0: holder name tag ('JIN' + NUL).
fields.evidence: Logical-domain ASCII 'JIN' at file offsets 0xA8-0xAB (EEPROM block 21) written by FUN_08006678. Third word of the 12-byte time-attack record starting at 0xA0; roster matches the versus-ranking names updated at match end near the FUN_080066dc call site (line 6340).
fields.name: ta_slot_0_name

fields.description: Time-attack record slot 1: best time in raw game ticks (187199 in baseline = slot-0 time + 3600).
fields.evidence: Logical u32 at file offset 0xB0 (EEPROM block 22) written by FUN_08006678 via FUN_08021cf0. Second word of the 12-byte time-attack record starting at 0xAC (index word = 1).
fields.name: ta_slot_1_time

fields.description: Time-attack record slot 1: holder name tag ('PAU' + NUL).
fields.evidence: Logical-domain ASCII 'PAU' at file offsets 0xB4-0xB7 (EEPROM block 22) written by FUN_08006678. Third word of the 12-byte time-attack record starting at 0xAC.
fields.name: ta_slot_1_name

fields.description: Versus-ranking row 0: character id (0 = JIN, top of the table).
fields.evidence: Logical u16 value 0 at file offset 0x118 (EEPROM block 35) written by FUN_08006678. Opens a 10-entry x 8-byte table (0x118-0x167) that exactly fills the written region end; ids ascend 0-8 down the rows while the paired counts descend, matching the char-keyed sorted-count ranking maintained by FUN_080066dc (10 entries, count sort, match-end update at line 6340).
fields.name: rank_0_char

fields.description: Versus-ranking row 0: win count (5 in baseline, highest in the table).
fields.evidence: Logical u16 value 5 at file offset 0x11A (EEPROM block 35) written by FUN_08006678. Count halfword of the 8-byte ranking row starting at 0x118; table counts descend 5,4,3,2,1.. consistent with the descending-count sort in FUN_080066dc.
fields.name: rank_0_wins

fields.description: Versus-ranking row 0: fighter name tag ('JIN' + NUL).
fields.evidence: Logical-domain ASCII 'JIN' at file offsets 0x11C-0x11F (EEPROM block 35) written by FUN_08006678. Name word of the 8-byte ranking row starting at 0x118.
fields.name: rank_0_name

fields.description: Versus-ranking row 1: win count (4 in baseline).
fields.evidence: Logical u16 value 4 at file offset 0x122 (EEPROM block 36) written by FUN_08006678. Count halfword of the 8-byte ranking row starting at 0x120 (char id 1, name 'PAU' at 0x124).
fields.name: rank_1_wins

fields.description: Versus-ranking row 1: fighter name tag ('PAU' + NUL).
fields.evidence: Logical-domain ASCII 'PAU' at file offsets 0x124-0x127 (EEPROM block 36) written by FUN_08006678. Name word of the 8-byte ranking row starting at 0x120.
fields.name: rank_1_name
